John Homer  Wash'n May 28th 1865 10. P. M
Rebecca harsh paddle for Kunkle zebra Mallory late
Walnut Ruston and B H Hill of Argus
have been ordered and are ordered to be
forwarded to you to be held in custody
at Saco Lafayette zodiac You will receive &
hold them there yoke Brutus good for them


J. R Gillmore  Wash May 28 1865
Growl May harsh paddle Sarah for Maxim Hilton Head
zebra John has ordered Judge Camp bell pedlar R
empty Hunt her and Sed don late Secy of
War toby sent to suco Pulaski toby held in held in
cuss toddy there until further orders unity they are
now at Galway & wilby forwarded many Zodiac Ewell
receive & hold them in safe cuss tady Brutus


J. C. Sullivan Nashville  Wash. May 29 / 65
Implore Julia Dawson for apple pork Have musty
route rolls stormed of all the narrowed limpid
inure and transport by verge when it 
is done upward amber
